newsitem.title: USA: Apogee Enterprises net up on glass sales.
newsitem.headline: Apogee Enterprises net up on glass sales.

text.p: Apogee Enterprises Inc said Thursday solid performances by its Glass Technologies and Auto Glass units helped the company post record earnings in the third quarter.

The company reported net income of $7.6 million, up from $5.2 million one year ago. Sales increased to $229 million from $215 million thanks primarily to gains in the glass and Building Products & Services divisions, Apogee said.
Apogee manufactures building products and services in addition to its glass technologies and auto glass operations.
Its stock was down 1/4 Thursday at 45.
